description: This file implements the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class responsible for handling execution approval prompts via a gateway connection, managing user prompts based on security policies, and integrating with application state and messaging systems.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages execution approval requests and user prompting via gateway communication, with methods to start, stop, and handle approval flow.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for approval request events and handling them asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for approval requests and cancels ongoing tasks.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop that subscribes to gateway stream and processes incoming push events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes individual push events, decodes approval requests, and determines whether to prompt the user or resolve automatically.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines whether a request should be presented to the user based on policies and context.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Computes a fallback decision when user prompt cannot be shown, based on allowlist and fallback policies.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves command/paths from the request for allowlist matching.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Checks if the user prompt should be presented based on session and activity context.
